# Cavaleiros da Ilha (Knights of the Isle)

> Free pixel-art logic puzzle for iPhone and Android by Daenamu Studio. Knights only move by jumping over other pieces; get them all to the towers to win the island. 100 levels, free, plays offline. Available in Portuguese (pt-BR), English, Spanish and Korean.

This is the official game website (in Portuguese). It shows the island in 3D, explains the rules, and has the gameplay trailer and screenshots.

Official names by language:

- Português (pt-BR): Cavaleiros da Ilha
- English: Knights of the Isle
- Español: Caballeros de la Isla
- 한국어: 섬의 기사들

Rules (as shown on the site):

- Knight: only moves by jumping, in a straight line, over one or more pieces, and lands on the first empty square.
- Dragon: slides forward and back along its own line and can open or block a path.
- Sheep and rock: never move.
- Tower: when empty it is a free square; with a knight inside it becomes a piece that others can jump over.

Key facts:

- Genre: logic puzzle, single player, pixel art; 5x5 board; 100 levels from Squire (Escudeiro) to Wizard (Mago); up to 3 stars per level
- Platforms: iOS (iPhone) and Android; free, with Google AdMob ads; no sign-up, works offline
- Developer and publisher: Daenamu Studio (https://namustudio.com.br/, Instagram @daenamu.studio)
- Game Instagram: @cavaleiros_da_ilha
- Support: suporte@namustudio.com.br
